title: Ramen Office Hours

slotsworth.name: Slotsworth
slotsworth.description: Relentlessly upbeat. Has already accepted on your behalf.

philosopher.name: The Philosopher
philosopher.description: An archetype, not a person: asks whether your company is a company or a feature, and waits a long time for the answer.

metrics.name: The Metrics One
metrics.description: An archetype, not a person: has never heard a number she did not want weekly.

vibes.name: The Vibes Partner
vibes.description: An archetype, not a person: judges the deck by how it feels in the room, and the room by its lighting.

questions.prompt: If the large platforms copy the feature, what remains?

answers.text: The workflow, the permissions and the habit of using it.
answers.reply: A reason to stay that does not fit on a release note.
Speed is an activity. What will it accumulate?

answers.text: We may be a feature; we are testing the wider need.
answers.reply: A small honest question can become a useful company.

questions.prompt: What would convince you this idea is wrong?

answers.text: If teams still use the old workflow after a month of supported trials.
answers.reply: A belief with an exit door. Encouraging.
Then this is a faith round. We do not lead those.

answers.text: If nobody pays at the price that covers our costs.
answers.reply: Good. Do not discount away the answer.

questions.prompt: Explain the demo without explaining the architecture.

answers.text: It turns the missed delivery list into a route the driver can actually use.
answers.reply: I can picture the person and the Tuesday.

answers.text: We orchestrate a multi-agent abstraction layer.
answers.reply: I can picture a diagram arguing with another diagram.

answers.text: It does one useful job, and we can show it.
answers.reply: Excellent. The room has one attention span.

questions.prompt: What happens when it is confidently wrong?

answers.text: It shows its evidence, stops the automatic action and lets a person correct it.
answers.reply: The correction is part of the product. Keep it visible.
The number was not the problem I was asking about.

answers.text: We fall back to the existing manual workflow.
answers.reply: An unglamorous landing is still a landing.

questions.prompt: What did your first customers do the second week?

answers.text: Seven of ten came back; two needed help and one left.
answers.reply: A cohort and a denominator. We can have a conversation.

answers.text: We have a lot of sign-ups.
answers.reply: A sign-up is a hello. I asked whether they stayed.
Please put inevitable in the forecast, not the actuals.

questions.prompt: Who can say yes to buying this?

answers.text: The person who does this work also controls the small team budget.
answers.reply: A buyer close enough to the problem to recognise it.
That is a distribution problem disguised as a market.

answers.text: We do not know yet; three buyer calls are booked.
answers.reply: Good. Bring the calls, including the uncomfortable one.

place.label: The Ramen demo floor behind the rope line

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: three robots, one bad. the partners stay behind the rope. observation first, water second.

steps.hint: Watch all three robots, call the bad one and spray it; keep the two good robots and partners dry.

lines.speaker: metrics
lines.text: We are in. Please let us announce it first; our post is already drafted.

place.label: The Embarcadero at Harrison St, facing southbound traffic
place.source: Hand-placed on the bay side of The Embarcadero near Harrison St; the roadway runs about 150/330 degrees here, so a board facing 330 faces oncoming southbound traffic

lines.speaker: metrics
lines.text: Useful demo. Send weekly numbers, including the weeks they go down.

lines.speaker: metrics
lines.text: Strong energy. Bring clearer evidence next time. Office Hours open again tomorrow.

summary: Book Office Hours at the Ramen house: answer three partners, then call the one bad robot in a live three-robot demo. Every outcome pays; a clean demo is what the partners remember.

provenance.review: Repeatable Office Hours built from the reviewed mission-4 interview and demo (content/missions/demoed-correctly.json); rewards follow docs/design.md, Side activities. Pending independent narrative review.
